sources.title: Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026
sources.claim_summary: Erin In The Morning, 'Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026' (Stonewall News, published 27 Aug 2026): a per-state legal-risk grading of anti-trans law. The adult map lists 'Do Not Travel (FL, ID, KS, TX)' and 'The Worst States (AL, AR, IA, IN, LA, MS, OH, OK, ND, SC, SD, TN, UT, WV, WY)' - this state is in the worst group. The update records Idaho's promotion to 'Do Not Travel' as the fourth such state after its felony bathroom ban (up to 5 years; partially court-blocked but in force wherever no gender-neutral option exists), Kansas's bounty-hunter civil-suit regime, and a national frame of 'Worst Policies In Effect'.
